paragraphs: Pope Tech sells a web accessibility platform along with training and support. Automated testing scans pages for accessibility issues, and guided manual tests can be scheduled and tracked alongside it. Pope Tech for Courses is integrated directly inside Canvas LMS, where course content is scanned and instructors get an accessibility guide.

A higher education page presents the platform as a way to improve digital accessibility across a whole .edu. Services listed for colleges include combined automated and manual testing, training plans, document prioritization and video captioning. Client types named on the about page include higher ed institutions, government agencies, banks and credit unions, ecommerce websites and web agencies.

Pope Tech and WebAIM work together to bring the WAVE Suite of tools to more websites. Scanning runs on the WAVE testing engine at a stated volume of millions of pages each month. Support includes an accessibility help desk staffed by accessibility specialists, plus quarterly webinars and an annual WebAIM training for training seat users.

quote.text: Accessibility is possible. Compliance is possible. Any organization can start improving their web accessibility today.
